        <p><strong>Governance Rules – Meeting Procedure for Council Meetings</strong></p>
<p>Melton City Council adopted its Governance Rules on 25 March 2024.  Chapter 2 of the Governance Rules is the Meeting Procedure for Council Meetings. </p>
<p>The purpose of Chapter 2 is to:</p>
<ul>
<li>provide for the election of the Mayor and any Deputy Mayor;</li>
<li>provide for the appointment of any Acting Mayor; and</li>
<li>provide for the procedures governing the conduct of Council meetings.</li>
</ul>
<p>The Meeting Procedure Chapter replaces the Meeting Procedure Local Law 2013.  </p>
<p><a title="document download" href="/files/assets/public/v/5/council/about-council/council-meetingsminutes/governance-rules.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Download the Governance Rules<span class="file-info">(PDF, 1MB)</span></a></p>

<h3>Meeting recordings</h3>
<p>As from 11 May 2020 Council meetings are live streamed and recorded and all meeting recordings are available from the relevant 'Live Stream' link located under each meeting date.</p>
<p>Prior to 11 May 2020, an audio recording of Council meetings was made.  The files are in .mp3 format and can be listened to online or downloaded to your computer.  The link to the audio recording of meetings is available at the relevant 'Audio' link located under each meeting date.</p>
<h3>Attendance</h3>
<p>All interested members of the public are invited to attend - for any further information please contact the Council's Civic Centre on 9747 7200.</p>
<h3>Public question time</h3>
<p>All questions must be received by no later than 10am on the day of the scheduled Meeting of Council.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.melton.vic.gov.au/Council/About-Council/Public-question-time" target="_self">Submit your public question/s to Council</a></p>
<h3>Notice of Motion Register</h3>
<p>Notices of Motion are written notices of Councillors that they intend to move a motion at a Council Meeting. This Register details the Notices of Motion moved by Councillors in the previous and current Council Terms.</p>
<p><a title="document download" href="/files/assets/public/v/10/council/about-council/council-meetingsminutes/notice-of-motion-register/notice-of-motion-register-october-2020-to-july-2026.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Notice of Motion Register<span class="file-info">(PDF, 714KB)</span></a></p>

        <p><strong>Governance Rules – Meeting Procedure for Council Meetings</strong></p>
<p>Melton City Council adopted its Governance Rules on 25 March 2024.  Chapter 2 of the Governance Rules is the Meeting Procedure for Council Meetings. </p>
<p>The purpose of Chapter 2 is to:</p>
<ul>
<li>provide for the election of the Mayor and any Deputy Mayor;</li>
<li>provide for the appointment of any Acting Mayor; and</li>
<li>provide for the procedures governing the conduct of Council meetings.</li>
</ul>
<p>The Meeting Procedure Chapter replaces the Meeting Procedure Local Law 2013.  </p>
<p><a title="document download" href="/files/assets/public/v/5/council/about-council/council-meetingsminutes/governance-rules.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Download the Governance Rules<span class="file-info">(PDF, 1MB)</span></a></p>

<h3>Meeting recordings</h3>
<p>As from 11 May 2020 Council meetings are live streamed and recorded and all meeting recordings are available from the relevant 'Live Stream' link located under each meeting date.</p>
<p>Prior to 11 May 2020, an audio recording of Council meetings was made.  The files are in .mp3 format and can be listened to online or downloaded to your computer.  The link to the audio recording of meetings is available at the relevant 'Audio' link located under each meeting date.</p>
<h3>Attendance</h3>
<p>All interested members of the public are invited to attend - for any further information please contact the Council's Civic Centre on 9747 7200.</p>
<h3>Public question time</h3>
<p>All questions must be received by no later than 10am on the day of the scheduled Meeting of Council.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.melton.vic.gov.au/Council/About-Council/Public-question-time" target="_self">Submit your public question/s to Council</a></p>
<h3>Notice of Motion Register</h3>
<p>Notices of Motion are written notices of Councillors that they intend to move a motion at a Council Meeting. This Register details the Notices of Motion moved by Councillors in the previous and current Council Terms.</p>
<p><a title="document download" href="/files/assets/public/v/10/council/about-council/council-meetingsminutes/notice-of-motion-register/notice-of-motion-register-october-2020-to-july-2026.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Notice of Motion Register<span class="file-info">(PDF, 714KB)</span></a></p>
